summary: Verified both UI changes to PpmScheduleDetail modal for seeded QA Fire Station PPM visit (20 Nov 2026, schedule_id 6f925557-d6b1-47cd-afc1-6705c80725ac, case 0bf5a90a-e9c4-454a-a1b1-912b5cebee4d). (1) Treadmill calibration block now renders TWO clearly labelled sections — 'SPEED (MPH)' and 'INCLINE (%)' — each with 4 readings; the Incline 15% / 14.6 reading is correctly flagged FAIL and rendered in text-rose-600 red with a ✗ marker. (2) The 'Print report' button (data-testid=ppm-detail-print) is visible in the modal footer, is clickable, and opens a new browser window containing a formatted 'Service Report' with site name 'QA Fire Station', machines-on-site info, engineer's workings, Technogym Run equipment, and a treadmill calibration section containing both 'Speed (mph)' and 'Incline (%)' rows (including the 14.6 fail value). API /api/svc/ppm/schedules/{id} returns calibration.machines[].readings with type speed|incline and per-reading result pass|fail (overall_result=fail), confirming backend contract. All behaviours match the review request.
critical_code_review_comments: PpmScheduleDetail.js is now ~319 lines, still OK but close to becoming unwieldy with print HTML, CalibrationReadings, VisitsPanel all co-located; could be split into VisitsPanel.jsx + CalibrationReadings.jsx + reportBuilder.js if more features are added.
printReport() opens window.open() with no user feedback if popup is blocked — consider showing a toast when win is null.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing seeded QA Fire Station PPM visit / SVC-00026 / case 0bf5a90a-e9c4-454a-a1b1-912b5cebee4d).

Modal exposes data-testids ppm-detail, ppm-visit-calibration, ppm-calib-machine-0-speed, ppm-calib-machine-0-incline, ppm-detail-print.
